entries.title: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas (Visa Code)
entries.availability: A Finnish consolidated rendition was located at 11/06/2024. EUR-Lex identifies 28/06/2024 as the latest overall consolidation, but a Finnish rendition for that later date was not verified. Council Implementing Decisions (EU) 2026/1454 and 2026/1733 suspend specified Visa Code provisions for visa-required nationals of Somalia and Guinea respectively; assess those separate dependencies for affected cases. Version-specific official external reference only; no raw bytes or local Finnish copy were captured.
